subject.title: fix(claws): harden add and remove lifecycle

question: Should the consented Claw-removal path be allowed to bypass the generic config-size-drop guard once its provenance and expected-state checks pass?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes a shared config-mutation protection for one experimental lifecycle path; source-level scope is narrow, but accepting that authorization boundary is a maintainer policy decision.

options.title: Approve the scoped bypass
options.body: Accept the override only for the existing consented Claw lifecycle caller after verifying its provenance and expected-state checks are the intended boundary.

options.title: Keep the generic guard
options.body: Require Claw removal to surface a recoverable diagnostic instead of bypassing the config-size-drop protection.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped bypass
recommendation.body: Accept the override only for the existing consented Claw lifecycle caller after verifying its provenance and expected-state checks are the intended boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently carried the merged Claws lifecycle implementation and authored this targeted follow-up.
